# compiler: main-debug  (<repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe)

# harness:  assert-stack.cmd   (cdb 10.0.26100.6584, x64)  -- re-runnable
# ran:      2026-08-07
# why:      dxc sends DXASSERT text to OutputDebugString and then __debugbreak()s
#           (include/dxc/Support/Global.h:300), so a plain run shows only
#           'Internal compiler error: Terminal Error 0x80000003' on stderr with no message,
#           file or line. The file and line are the whole point here.
# NOTE:     hand-driven capture, not a probe. Not scored by match.json.
#           Stacks trimmed by trim-cdb.py; module-load and symbol-path noise removed.
#
# CASE 1  repro.hlsl, exactly as filed, with the arguments in cmd.txt. The assert is
#         DXASSERT(argIdx < endArgIdx, "arg index out of bound") at
#         lib/Transforms/Scalar/ScalarReplAggregatesHLSL.cpp:4791, in AllocateSemanticIndex.
#         The frames below match the ones @Dwedit posted in 2021 -- recursive
#         AllocateSemanticIndex under SROA_Parameter_HLSL::allocateSemanticIndex under
#         flattenArgument -- so the code path has not moved in five years.
# CASE 2  variant-minimal.hlsl -- a uniform Texture2D entry-point parameter with a semantic
#         and nothing else. SAME assert, SAME file, SAME line, SAME frames. This is the
#         evidence for @damyanp's 2024-07-09 comment that matrices are not involved.
# CASE 3  control-no-semantic.hlsl -- the repro with only the `: TEXUNIT0` semantic removed.
#         No trap: the only break is the loader's, and the stack after 'g' shows the process
#         leaving through exit(). See variant-control-no-semantic-main-debug.txt for the
#         diagnostic it prints and its exit status (0x80004005).
# CASE 4  variant-no-uniform.hlsl -- CASE 2 with the `uniform` keyword dropped and nothing
#         else changed. SAME assert, SAME line 4791, SAME frames, so `uniform` is not part
#         of the trigger: a semantic on a resource-typed entry-point parameter is enough.
